example.title: San Joaquin River Viaduct (California High-Speed Rail)

brief: The railway over the Miami River (West Coast). Modelled on the San Joaquin River Viaduct, completed 2021: a 1,445 m concrete rail viaduct of precast girders on column bents across the floodplain, crossing the river itself on a double concrete arch, with a concrete pergola over the older tracks beside it. Here: the ballasted double-track deck on precast girders across the basin, and the twin concrete arches over the channel. Plain cast concrete. Foundations: cast-in-drilled-hole piles 25 m below the modelled bed.
